crossing_forbidden.predicate: crossing_forbidden(T) is true iff T is, or contains by member (recursively through arrays and member records) or by base (recursively), a record with a virtual base, or contains or is a pointer to member

terms.gcc: for a RECORD_TYPE R with TYPE_BINFO: any binfo reached from TYPE_BINFO(R) through BINFO_BASE_BINFO whose BINFO_VIRTUAL_P is true; R and every member type that is a record or an array of records, recursively
terms.reason: Visual C++ keeps a vbptr and a vbtable, GCC (Itanium) a vtable with virtual-base offsets: sizes can agree, layouts do not; no msvcmodel patch

terms.gcc: TYPE_PTRMEM_P(T), i.e. TYPE_PTRDATAMEM_P (data member) or TYPE_PTRMEMFUNC_P (member function), for T and for every member type, recursively
terms.reason: a function pointer to member is 8 bytes under GCC and 4 bytes (single inheritance) in MSVC, and the representation depends on the inheritance model; a data member pointer is 4 bytes on both (a 4-byte offset) but its representation of the null value is not documented by Microsoft, so it is forbidden too
